```artifact
Feature: Patient Appointment Management

  Scenario: Query Patient Details by Patient Id
    Given a patient with id "PAT-001" exists
    When I query patient details by patient id "PAT-001"
    Then patient details are displayed
    And patient pin-code is displayed
    And patient pin-code cannot be modified to be outside the Zone

  Scenario: Create Patient Appointment
    Given a patient with id "PAT-001" exists
    And a doctor with id "DOC-001" exists
    When I query patient details by patient id "PAT-001"
    And I enter details like Speciality "Cardiology" and Symptoms "Chest Pain"
    And I request for consultation
    Then appointment is created for next day
    And appointment date is displayed

  Scenario: Doctor Provides Consultation
    Given a patient with id "PAT-001" exists
    And a doctor with id "DOC-001" exists
    And a consultation request for patient "PAT-001" exists
    When doctor selects consultation request
    Then consultation is provided
    And diagnosis is entered
    And medicines are prescribed (max 8)
    And lab tests are requested (max 5)

  Scenario: Chemist Dispenses Medicines
    Given a patient with id "PAT-001" exists
    And a doctor with id "DOC-001" exists
    And a consultation request for patient "PAT-001" exists
    And a prescription for patient "PAT-001" exists
    When chemist selects consultation request
    Then medicines are dispensed
    And flag is marked in prescription

  Scenario: Lab Notes Lab Tests
    Given a patient with id "PAT-001" exists
    And a doctor with id "DOC-001" exists
    And a consultation request for patient "PAT-001" exists
    And a prescription for patient "PAT-001" exists
    When lab selects consultation request
    Then lab tests are noted
    And patient details are displayed
    And flag is marked in prescription
    And report is added

  Scenario Outline: Patient Appointment Management with Different Pin-Codes
    Given a patient with id "PAT-001" exists
    And a doctor with id "DOC-001" exists
    When I query patient details by patient id "PAT-001"
    And I enter pin-code "<pin-code>"
    Then pin-code is validated
    Examples:
      | pin-code |
      | 1234     |
      | 5678     |
      | 9012     |
      | 1111     |  # invalid pin-code (outside Zone)

  Scenario Outline: Patient Appointment Management with Different Medicine Counts
    Given a patient with id "PAT-001" exists
    And a doctor with id "DOC-001" exists
    When I query patient details by patient id "PAT-001"
    And I prescribe medicines "<medicine-count>"
    Then medicine count is validated
    Examples:
      | medicine-count |
      | 0              |
      | 1              |
      | 8              |
      | 9              |  # invalid medicine count (exceeds limit)

  Scenario Outline: Patient Appointment Management with Different Lab Test Counts
    Given a patient with id "PAT-001" exists
    And a doctor with id "DOC-001" exists
    When I query patient details by patient id "PAT-001"
    And I request lab tests "<lab-test-count>"
    Then lab test count is validated
    Examples:
      | lab-test-count |
      | 0              |
      | 1              |
      | 5              |
      | 6              |  # invalid lab test count (exceeds limit)
```
